caption:
NASA is pushing forward to bring real rocks back from Mars. But what if those sample tubes contain living alien microbes? If microscopic Martian life exists, returning it could introduce biology our planet has never encountered. To prevent biological contamination of Earth, sample-return missions follow strict planetary protection principles. Scientists aim to preserve the pristine nature of celestial bodies while studying them in high-containment facilities. Discovering extraterrestrial life wouldn't spark an apocalypse, but it would change science forever. Would you trust a local lab holding alien microbes? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: NASA kick-starts a fresh push to bring Mars samples home - Space
